attacks.name: Bio-Electric Strike
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.

|!wild| |*Neuro-Disruption|: Before |!damage| is dealt, for each |!wild| in the attack roll, the defender gains 1 of the following special conditions: |§poison§Poison|, |§shock§Shock|, or |§stun§Stun|.

attacks.name: Intoxicating Blast
steps: |!wild| |*Sensory Overload|: If the defender has the |§poison§Poison| special condition, before |!damage| is dealt, this character may Advance it |!range_small|.
After this attack is resolved, the defender drops all objective tokens it is holding.

superPowers.name: I Don‘t Fly, I Glide
superPowers.body: Place this character within |!range| 2 of its current position. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Interrogate
superPowers.body: At the start of the |*Cleanup Phase|, if this character is within |!range| 2 of 1 or more Dazed enemy characters, it may use this superpower. Its controlling player increases the amount of VPs they score from Crisis Cards during this |*Cleanup Phase| by 1.

superPowers.name: Martial Artist
superPowers.body: When this character is defending against a |!physical| or |!energy| attack, if the attacker is within |!range| 2, this character adds Blanks in its defense roll to its total successes.
